content.title: This Is When New Episodes Of Euphoria Season 3 Come Out In Australia
content.text: They're back Euphoria Season 3 | Trailer 2 | HBO Max0 seconds of 3 minutes, 8 secondsVolume 0% THE RUNDOWN Euphoria season 3 premiered on Monday, 13 April 2026, at 11 am AEST in Australia. The previous two seasons of Euphoria and season three have moved from Binge to HBO where new episodes will be released weekly, Zendaya, Jacob Elordi, Sydney Sweeney, Hunter Schafer and Alexa Demi are some of the stars returning for the final season. Last week the cast of Euphoria season 3 hit the red carpet, and now the final season of potentially the most controversial teen drama in TV history is here. Fans of Sam Levinson’s gritty high school drama have waited four years for this instalment, and a lot has changed. Euphoria cast members, including Zendaya, Jacob Elordi and Sydney Sweeney, have become bona fide A-listers — some as controversial as the series itself. The series has also had its tragedies and challenges. In 2023, the Hollywood Writers’ Strike delayed production, and the cast mourned the passing of Angus Cloud, who played beloved character Fezco. Levinson also released the controversial series The Idol, which, despite Lily-Rose Depp’s hotly anticipated performance, was roundly panned by critics. HBO confirmed the series would be returning in April 2026 late last year, and drip-fed trailers teasing where the characters are now. After their fraught courtship, Cassie and Nate are getting married and struggling to make the American dream a reality with Cassie is experimenting with her “online presence” and Nate out of his deph with his father’s business. Trouble is mounting for Rue and from first looks at Maddy Perez and Jules’s styling, the fashion and beauty might be enough to lure back fans who’ve grown weary of Levinson’s approach to female sexuality. It’s been too long since we’ve seen Alexa Demie and Hunter Schafer on our small screens. With the first episode wrapped, here’s everything you need to know about the release schedule. When Do New Episodes of Euphoria Come Out Each Week? Euphoria season 3 premiered Sunday, 12 April 2026, at 9 p.m. ET/PT on HBO and Max. This converts to Monday, 13 April 2026, at 11 a.m. AEST. The final season consists of eight episodes, all around an hour in length, and will air every Monday until the finale on May 31, 2026 (June 1 AEST). See the full time conversion below. Seasons one and two are available to stream on HBO Max in Australia.The series was previously hosted on Binge, but the platform lost the rights following HBO’s local Australian launch in March, which switched the HBO-owned series to its home streaming service. Despite the controversy since its debut in 2019, Euphoria has become a cultural touchstone, reshaping what teen drama looks like and reflecting the technology-saturated world many Gen Z and millennials came of age in, while tackling issues like prescription substance abuse, trans identity and teen-on-teen domestic violence. It has also exerted an enormous influence on beauty and fashion, with lead makeup artist Donni Davy launching her own cosmetics line. Most of the core cast is returning: Alexa Demie, Colman Domingo, Eric Dane, Chloe Cherry, Maude Apatow, Dominic Fike, Nika King, Martha Kelly, Alanna Ubach, Schafer, Sweeney, Zendaya and Elordi. New additions include Danielle Deadwyler, Eli Roth, Marshawn Lynch, Natasha Lyonne, Rosalía, Sharon Stone and Trisha Paytas. Barbie Ferreira departed the series in 2022. Storm Reid, who plays Rue’s younger sister Gia, will also be absent, as will Austin Abrams and Algee Smith.
